title: Christmas bookings are open at The Anchor
preheader: Your own table, everyone picks their own courses, and free parking on the door.

image.alt: A table laid for Christmas dinner at The Anchor

data.placeholder_caption: Christmas table laid up, warm low light
data.headline: Your team's Christmas, not a shared party night
body: We serve Christmas dinner from 10 November to 20 December. Your group gets its own table and its own evening, never a shared sitting with another company.
Everyone picks their own courses too, so nobody is stuck with whatever the table agreed back in October.

rows.label: Sittings
rows.value: Tuesday to Saturday, plus Sunday 1pm to 6pm. Never Mondays

rows.label: Group size
rows.value: 6 guests or more. Over 20 becomes a private hire

rows.label: Deposit
rows.value: £10 per person, taken off your bill

data.heading: What your team gets
body: Every adult gets a glass of prosecco, swappable for orange juice. Christmas dinner comes with pigs in blankets, stuffing, Yorkshire pudding, roast potatoes, mash, peas and sprouts.
list_items: Everyone picks their own courses, rather than one choice the whole table commits to
Pre-orders reach us 7 days before, so you are not chasing people on the day
A Christmas quiz runs through the season, and a DJ can be arranged if you want one

data.heading: Two ways to do it
data.body: Smaller teams book a table like any other booking. Larger ones become a private hire, which means the space is yours and we plan it with you.

image.alt: A team sitting down to Christmas dinner at The Anchor

cards.heading: Six to twenty
cards.body: Book a table and the evening is yours. Six guests is the minimum for the Christmas menu.

image.alt: The Anchor set up for a standing Christmas party

cards.heading: Over twenty
cards.body: That becomes a private hire. Up to 60 seated, or 200 standing if you would rather people mingled.

data.label: Thirty or more, standing?
data.body: The festive buffets are built for exactly that, and thirty guests is the minimum on all of them.

data.text: December Fridays and Saturdays go first.

items.question: Will we be sat with another company?
items.answer: No. Your group gets its own table and its own evening. We do not run shared party nights.

items.question: Can people choose their own meals?
items.answer: Yes. Every guest picks their own courses, so the vegetarian is not an afterthought.

items.question: How far ahead do you need everyone's choices?
items.answer: Seven days before your date, for the two and three course menus.

items.question: What about parking and getting home?
items.answer: Around 20 free spaces on site, we sit outside the ULEZ, and we are seven minutes from Terminal 5 and eight from Staines.

data.body: Tell us your date and rough numbers and we will come back to you within 24 hours.

data.ps_body: Pre-orders are due seven days before your date, so the earlier it is in the diary, the less chasing you end up doing.

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you enquired about a booking or an event with us, or because you may be close to us and we thought this information would be helpful to you.
